1.overview: In the second year of Darius, Haggai tells Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the people that their neglect of the ruined temple contrasts with their paneled houses, and he calls them to rebuild it as the LORD explains the scarcity affecting their land. Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the remnant obey, receive the LORD’s assurance of presence, and begin work on the temple on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month.

sections.heading: The Call to Rebuild and Its Consequences

2.overview: Haggai tells Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the people to work on the temple, promising that the LORD is with them and that its latter glory and peace will exceed its former glory as the LORD shakes the nations. The LORD uses a ruling from the priests to declare the people’s work defiled, recalls their poor harvests, promises blessing from the day the temple foundation is laid, and tells Zerubbabel that he is chosen as the LORD’s signet ring when kingdoms are overturned.
